problem: Firmware reports ambient.stopped/overflow followed by error/overflow. The application-wide error handler cancelled the controller recovery timer, leaving an online device permanently paused.
previous_issue: Per-utterance provider_reaction_format failure isolation remains enabled.
changes: Treat the paired board notifications as one ambient failure; preserve the existing recovery task.
Standalone board overflow cancels stale work and resumes enabled background listening; late cleanup and released-connection events cannot revive capture.
Wait for interrupted owner work to finish before a scheduled background resume.
Direct hearing questions now select the continuous agree/nod gesture locally on their first utterance; quoted, conditional and complex understanding questions defer.
